name: Meg Flushes and Leaves the Bathroom
description: Meg stands up and flushes the toilet.
related_events: Meg stands up and flushes the toilet

name: Meg Drags Sarah into the Hallway
description: On the top floor, Meg grabs Sarah and pulls her out of the room, moving her quickly into the hallway.
related_events: Meg drags Sarah out of the room and into the hallway

name: Three Men Ascend the Stairs
description: The three men walk out of the kitchen and start climbing the staircase. Their movement is steady as they make their way upward, visible on the monitor.
related_events: Three men leave the kitchen and ascend the stairs

name: Meg Finds the Bathroom Door in the Dark
description: Using the light spilling from the open panic room door, Meg moves back into the master bedroom. She searches the dim room and locates the correct door to the bathroom.
related_events: Meg locates the bathroom door using light from the panic room

name: Raoul Warns Allies from Elevator
description: Raoul turns toward the open stairwell and shouts from inside the elevator. He calls out that two people are coming, both headed toward those in the stairwell.
related_events: Raoul shouts a warning into the stairwell

name: Meg Refills Her Wine Glass in the Bathtub
description: Meg soaks in the bathtub, her body still in the water. She picks up her wine glass, tilts it to drink the last sip, then sets it down. She reaches over the edge of the tub, grabs the wine bottle from the floor, and pours more wine into the glass. She sets the bottle back down and lifts the glass, holding it in her hand as she settles back into the bath.
related_events: Meg finishes the last of her wine and refills her glass

name: Meg Tries to Wake Sarah
description: Meg bursts into Sarah's room, rushes to the bed, and climbs onto it. She grabs Sarah by the shoulders and shakes her gently, urging her to wake up. Sarah does not respond, her breathing slow and steady, deep in sleep.
related_events: Meg enters Sarah's room and attempts to wake her

name: Meg Leaps to Her Feet and Dashes Out of the Room
description: Meg suddenly rises and runs out of the room.
related_events: Meg leaps to her feet and dashes out of the room

name: Meg Flees to the Top Floor
description: Meg races across her bedroom, flings open the door, and sprints into the hallway. She reaches the carpeted stairs and bolts up them, heading for the top floor.
related_events: Meg races across her bedroom and exits through the door
Meg bolts up the carpeted stairs toward the top floor

name: Meg Wakes Sarah with Water
description: Meg, seeing Sarah unresponsive, grabs a plastic cup half-filled with water from the night table. She throws the water in Sarah's face. Sarah jerks awake, sputtering and shouting, demanding to know why Meg did that.
related_events: Meg throws water on Sarah to wake her up
Sarah wakes up and reacts angrily

name: Meg Tests the Kitchen Phone and Calls Perry's Pizza
description: Meg picks up the wall phone in the kitchen and listens for a dial tone. She confirms the phone is working and tells Sarah, 'Hey, I hooked up the phone.' Sarah replies sarcastically, 'The crowd goes wild.' Meg ignores the comment and finishes dialing a number. The phone rings, and a voice answers, saying, 'Perry's Pizza, please hold.'
related_events: Meg tests the wall phone and confirms it works
Meg dials a number and reaches Perry's Pizza

name: Alarm Panel Shows Zone 19 Disabled
description: In the master bedroom, the alarm panel lights up with a message: ZONE 19 DISABLED.
related_events: Alarm panel displays disabled zone message

name: Turn Off the Panic Room Lights
description: Meg rolls over, preparing to go back to sleep, and notices the lights are still on in the panic room. She tskes quietly, gets out of bed, and walks across the floor toward the panic room.
related_events: Meg notices lights are on in the panic room
Meg gets out of bed and walks to the panic room

name: Meg Takes Advil Without Water
description: Meg snaps the cap off a jug of Advil and dumps three pills into her palm. She pops them into her mouth, looks around for a glass but finds none, then bends to the spout of the jug for a gulp of water to wash the pills down. Afterward, she turns toward the toilet.
related_events: Meg takes Advil without water

name: Raoul Responds to the Child's Shout
description: Raoul stands at the base of the stairs when he hears a child shouting. He immediately begins climbing the stairs, moving quickly upward.
related_events: Raoul hears the kid shouting at the base of the stairs
Raoul starts ascending the stairs quickly

name: Meg Wakes and Drinks Water in Bed
description: Meg stirs in bed, her eyes fluttering open as she pushes herself up with a groggy motion. She reaches for a glass of water on the nightstand and drinks it quickly. After setting the glass down, she lies back on the pillow and closes her eyes.
related_events: Meg awakens groggily from alcohol-induced sleep
Meg drinks water to alleviate hangover symptoms
Meg lies back down after drinking water

name: Meg Sees the Intruders on Screen
description: Meg steps into the panic room and reaches for the light switch, then freezes. She tilts her head, staring at the video monitors. On the screens, three men in dark clothes move silently across the foyer. She takes a step forward, eyes fixed on the images. Slowly, she sinks to her knees, bringing her face close to the monitors. She reaches out and touches the screens, her fingers pressing against the glass.
related_events: Meg discovers intruders on video monitors in the panic room
Three intruders stealthily enter the foyer

name: Junior slips and falls on the stairs
description: Junior leads the way down the stairs. As he reaches a bend at the base, his foot lands short on an angled step and slips. He loses balance and falls forward.
related_events: Junior slips on an angled step while descending stairs
Junior falls forward after losing balance on stairs

name: Sarah Reads 'Tom Swift' to Meg
description: Sarah sits in her twin bed, the room still cluttered with unpacked boxes, and reads aloud from 'Tom Swift and His Repelatron Skyway.' Her hair is damp, and she wears pajamas. Meg lies beside her, drowsy, listening as Sarah's voice moves through the story. The words fill the quiet room—Tom calling out to his father, trapped inside the machine, his throat dry, the scientist rushing to switch off the motor, calling for a solvent. Sarah turns the page, continuing the tale as Meg settles closer, eyes heavy.
related_events: Sarah reads aloud from 'Tom Swift and His Repelatron Skyway'
Meg lies drowsily beside Sarah while listening to a story

name: Intruder Enters Through Roof Hatch
description: The silver tool slips free from the roof access panel, which is then lifted away. The hatch opens to reveal a stretch of night sky dense with stars. A man peers down through the opening, then steps over the edge and descends the ladder in silence. He drops into the closet, now fully inside.
related_events: Intruder removes roof access panel and enters closet
Man climbs down ladder from roof access hatch

name: Collapse on the Floor and Find a Dead Phone
description: Sarah and Meg lie sprawled on the black and white tile of the entry floor, surrounded by moving boxes. They are breathing heavily, arms and legs stretched out, staring up at the ceiling. Sarah mutters that there are too many stairs. Meg replies that she got them into the house, and Sarah says they should have gotten an apartment. Meg admits she knows that now. Meg lifts her hand, holding her cell phone, and sees that the battery is dead.
related_events: Sarah and Meg collapse on the entry floor after moving
Meg discovers her cell phone battery is dead

name: Meg Witnesses Junior's Near-Fall on the Stairs
description: Meg watches the video monitors as Junior slips on the stairs. She sees him lurch forward, his hands slapping against the railing as he catches himself. The sound carries through the open door of the panic room. Meg gasps, her eyes widening in horror.
related_events: Junior slips on the stairs and catches himself
Meg gasps in horror upon seeing Junior's slip

name: Meg Walks to the Bathroom in the Dark
description: Meg sits up in bed, her head throbbing. She swings her legs over the side, stands, and moves unsteadily across the room. In the darkness, she stretches her arms ahead, hands brushing the walls and air as she makes her way toward the bathroom. She steps through the doorway and is inside.
related_events: Meg wakes up with a headache and gets out of bed
Meg stumbles toward the bathroom in the dark
Meg enters the bathroom

name: Junior and Raoul Search Different Paths
description: Junior and Raoul reach the third floor landing. Junior walks down the hall toward the master bedroom. Raoul moves toward the stairs that lead to the top floor.
related_events: Junior and Raoul arrive at the third floor landing
Junior moves toward the master bedroom
Raoul heads toward the stairs to the top floor

name: Meg Pretends to Sleep as the Man Watches
description: Meg lies in bed on her side, eyes open, her head pounding from a hangover after drinking too much wine the night before. The bedroom door creaks open silently, and the Man steps into the doorway, pausing to look at her. Her back is to him, and she doesn’t move, staying completely still despite being wide awake. After a moment, he turns and walks quietly down the hall, out of sight. As soon as he disappears, Meg rolls over to face the doorway, closes her eyes, and lies still, trying once more to fall asleep.
related_events: Meg struggles with hangover symptoms in bed
The Man silently opens the bedroom door and observes Meg
The Man quietly moves away from the bedroom door and down the hall
Meg turns over and attempts to sleep again after the Man leaves

name: The Man Finds Sarah Amid the Moving Boxes
description: The bedroom door glides open slowly, revealing Sarah asleep in bed, the covers kicked off. Around her, the room is filled with a mountain of moving boxes. The Man stands in the doorway, motionless, his eyes fixed on the clutter and on Sarah. He stares, his lips moving silently, forming a word without sound.
related_events: The bedroom door slowly glides open
Sarah sleeps in her bedroom with covers kicked off
The Man enters Sarah's bedroom doorway and stares at the moving boxes and Sarah
The Man silently mouths a word while staring at Sarah in her bedroom

name: Evan, Lydia, and Meg Tour the Upper Floor
description: Evan, Lydia, and Meg moved quickly from room to room, glancing into each as they made their way through the upper floor. They stepped into a spacious bedroom that faced the courtyard. Evan pointed around as he spoke, noting there were two bedrooms and one bathroom on the top level.
related_events: Evan, Lydia, and Meg tour a series of rooms quickly
Group inspects upstairs bedroom with courtyard view
Evan describes top-floor layout

name: Meg Arms the Alarm System
description: Meg stands in the master bedroom wearing an old Knicks T-shirt and boxer shorts, reading from an instruction manual beside the alarm panel. She presses a few buttons, slurring under her breath, but the panel emits a sharp beep. Frowning, she sinks down to sit on the floor, turning the manual toward the light. Her fingers move over the keypad again, more deliberately now—pressing shunt, then enter, then shunt once more, followed by a zone number. After a moment, a small red light on the panel glows steadily. The display reads: SYSTEM ARMED.
related_events: Meg attempts to bypass non-ready zones on the alarm panel
Alarm panel rejects Meg's input with a disapproving beep
Meg sits on the floor to focus on understanding the alarm instructions
Meg successfully arms the alarm system after manipulating the panel

name: Junior Takes Charge and Divides the Team
description: Junior rises to his feet and points at Raoul, speaking in an urgent whisper. He tells Raoul to go to the top floor and get the little girl, to keep her there. He holds out his hand for the gun, and Raoul gives it to him. Junior then points at Burnham and tells him to stay in the living room, to let nobody get past. He heads for the stairs, and Raoul follows close behind. Burnham stays behind, motionless, visibly reluctant.
related_events: Junior stands up and issues urgent instructions
Raoul hands over the gun to Junior
Junior orders Burnham to guard the living room
Junior and Raoul head toward the stairs
Burnham remains in the living room with reluctance

name: Activate Surveillance and Alarm in Panic Room
description: She stepped into the panic room and the dozen small video screens flickered to life, each showing a different view of the house. The alarm system engaged with a low chime, confirming the house was now secured for the night. Behind her, the door to the master bedroom stood open, revealing the dim outline of a makeshift tent built from blankets and couch cushions in the center of the floor.
related_events: Video screens in panic room activate unexpectedly
Alarm system is activated for the night
Panic room door remains open to master bedroom

name: Sarah Builds a Blanket Tent in the Bedroom
description: Sarah arranges blankets and couch cushions into a small tent on the floor of the master bedroom. The structure sits in the middle of the room, made from household items gathered and arranged by her before bed.
related_events: Child constructs blanket and cushion tent in bedroom

name: Meg and Sarah Flee into the Elevator
description: Meg and Sarah stepped out of Sarah's bedroom just as Raoul reached the top of the stairs at the other end of the hallway. Meg froze, her eyes locking onto the ski-masked figure. She glanced to her right—the bathroom, a dead end—then to her left. Spotting the elevator, she yanked the door open, shoved aside the gate, and rushed inside with Sarah. Raoul broke into a sprint down the hall, lunging toward the elevator as the doors began to close.
related_events: Meg and Sarah exit Sarah's bedroom
Raoul arrives at the top of the stairs
Meg freezes upon seeing Raoul
Meg assesses escape routes in the hallway
Meg forces open the elevator door and enters with Sarah
Raoul lunges down the hallway toward the elevator

name: Hearing Movement Above and Masking Up
description: Burnham, Raoul, and Junior step up from the kitchen and freeze as they hear water running in the pipes overhead. Footsteps creak across the floor above their heads. They watch the ceiling, tracking the sound until it stops, followed by the squeak of bedsprings as someone climbs back into bed. A silence settles. Raoul reaches into his jacket, pulls out a ski mask, and pulls it over his head. The others look at him. He whispers, 'No face.' Burnham rolls his eyes. Without another word, they begin moving across the foyer toward the stairs.
related_events: Characters hear footsteps and bedsprings from upstairs
Raoul puts on a ski mask
Raoul whispers warning about concealing identity

name: Burnham, Raoul, and Junior Cross the Foyer Toward the Stairs
description: After hearing footsteps above and the creak of bedsprings as someone climbs back into bed, Burnham, Raoul, and Junior stand still for a moment in silence. Raoul pulls a ski mask from his jacket and pulls it over his head. Burnham watches him, unimpressed. Without speaking, the three begin to move across the foyer toward the stairs.
related_events: Group moves toward the stairs after hearing noises above

name: Woman Mistakes Panic Room for Bathroom
description: She walks into a dark room, reaching for a light switch, thinking she is in the bathroom. Her fingers find the switch, and she flips it on. Harsh overhead lights flash on, revealing a wall of glowing video monitors. She blinks, disoriented, then turns and steps back out, closing the door behind her. The screens show three men standing silently in the kitchen, unaware they are being watched.
related_events: Woman enters room mistaking it for the bathroom
Woman searches for light switch in dark room
Woman discovers harsh lighting after flipping switch
Woman realizes she is inside the panic room

name: Woman Leaves Panic Room, Intruders Visible on Monitors
description: She steps out of the room, leaving the lights on behind her. The video monitors along the wall remain illuminated, showing the three men in the kitchen, standing close together in silence, their faces intent as they watch the screens.
related_events: Woman exits panic room leaving lights on
Camera reveals intruders observing on video monitors

name: Eat Pizza in Silence
description: Meg and Sarah sit at a small table in the kitchen surrounded by packing boxes. They eat pizza without speaking. Sarah drinks a diet Dr. Pepper. Meg finishes a glass of wine and pours herself another. Sarah notices Meg's moist eyes. Meg shrugs when she realizes she’s been noticed. Sarah looks away and continues eating.
related_events: Meg and Sarah eat pizza in silence amid packing boxes
Sarah notices Meg's moist eyes

name: Sarah and Meg Share Pizza in Silence
description: Night has fallen. Meg and Sarah sit at a small table in the middle of the kitchen, surrounded by packing boxes. They eat pizza, chewing in silence. Sarah drinks a diet Dr. Pepper. Meg finishes a glass of wine and pours herself another as Sarah watches. Meg's eyes are moist. Sarah notices, and Meg shrugs. "I'm human, what do you want me to do, hide it?" Sarah looks away, then says, "Fuck him." Meg says, "Don't." Sarah adds, "Fuck her too." Meg looks at her, then says, "I agree. But don't." Sarah stares at her for a moment, then goes back to eating.
related_events: Sarah expresses anger toward absent figures
Meg cautiously agrees but urges restraint
Meg defends her emotional reaction

name: Meg Pours Another Glass
description: Meg picks up the wine bottle and pours another glass. Sarah watches her closely, her eyes following the glug of wine as it fills the glass.
related_events: Meg pours more wine under Sarah's watchful gaze

name: Meg Prepares for Bed
description: Meg makes the bed in the master bedroom. She fills a glass with water and places it on a box she uses as a night table. She plugs in a charger, places her cell phone in the cradle, and it beeps, displaying 'Charging.' She sets the digital clock and puts it beside the glass of water. It reads 12:26. She gets into bed on the left side, lying in the dark, with the empty space of the bed stretching out beside her. The clock ticks over as the time changes.
related_events: Meg makes her bed in the master bedroom
Meg fills a glass with water and places it on a makeshift night table
Meg sets the digital clock next to the water glass
Meg charges her cell phone

name: Meg Gets Into Bed and Watches the Clock
description: Meg gets into bed on the left side, the side she always uses. The bed is wide and empty beside her. The room is dark. A digital clock sits on a box near a glass of water, displaying 12:26. The numbers shift. The time changes to 12:27.
related_events: Meg gets into bed on her usual side
Time changes on the digital clock from 12:26 to 12:27

name: Meg Initiates Elevator Escape
description: Meg slams the elevator gate shut and presses the button for the first floor. The elevator groans and begins to descend slowly. As it moves down, Sarah looks up at Meg, her face filled with fear. Through the window in the elevator door, Raoul appears, dropping to his knees to peer inside.
related_events: Meg slams elevator gate shut and presses first floor button
Elevator groans and begins descending slowly

name: Sarah Reacts in Fear as Meg Reveals Intruders
description: The elevator groans as it begins its slow descent. Sarah looks up at Meg, her face filled with terror, and shouts, 'What's going on?!' Meg slams the gate shut and presses the button for the first floor. 'People,' she says. 'In the house.' Through the window in the elevator door, Raoul appears, dropping to his knees to peer inside.
related_events: Sarah looks up at Meg with terror
Sarah demands to know what is happening
Meg warns about people in the house

name: Raoul Kneels to Peer Through the Elevator Door
description: As the elevator descends, Raoul drops to his knees outside and presses his face close to the window in the door, staring in at Meg and Sarah.
related_events: Raoul kneels to look through elevator door window

name: Junior races to the elevator to reach Meg and Sarah
description: Junior turns from the open doorway of the master bedroom and sprints down the hall toward the elevator. He reaches the door and peers through the window, spotting the bare feet of Meg and Sarah as they descend on the other side. He grabs the handle and pulls hard, but the door remains locked as the elevator continues downward. He presses the button repeatedly, but the elevator does not stop. For a brief moment, he sees Meg’s eyes meet his through the gap as they move out of sight.
related_events: Junior races toward the elevator after leaving the master bedroom
Junior sees Meg and Sarah's feet through the elevator door window

name: Junior tries to stop the elevator as Meg and Sarah descend
description: Junior turns from the master bedroom doorway and runs back down the hall to the elevator. He reaches the door and peers through the window, seeing Meg and Sarah's bare feet descending past the opening. He grabs the handle and pulls hard, but the door remains locked as the elevator continues moving. He starts pressing the button repeatedly, watching through the window as Meg and Sarah come fully into view. Their eyes meet briefly, but the elevator does not stop—it keeps going down.
related_events: Junior attempts to open the locked elevator door
Junior bangs on the elevator button to stop the descent

name: Junior's Final Glimpse of Meg in the Descending Elevator
description: Junior stood at the hallway door, pressing against the window as the elevator descended. Meg and Sarah came fully into view inside the cabin. Junior locked eyes with Meg for a brief moment, their gazes meeting as the elevator continued downward. He pulled at the door handle and slammed the call button, but the elevator did not stop. It moved beyond his reach, carrying Meg and Sarah out of sight.
related_events: Meg and Sarah descend fully into view inside the elevator
Junior makes eye contact with Meg as the elevator moves downward
Elevator continues descending without stopping

name: Meg Notices a Strange Corner in the Master Bedroom
description: The group enters the master bedroom. Meg looks around, studying the room's dimensions. She focuses on the far wall near the closet entrance, where two mirrors—one on the closet door and one mounted beside it—are slightly angled toward each other. She takes two steps back and points to the corner, saying something seems off. Evan smiles, admitting he was waiting for her to notice. He presses the top of the wall mirror, which clicks and opens a few inches. He swings it fully open, revealing a hidden panel in the wall. He presses again at the top and bottom of the panel, each time producing a click. The panel pulls open, revealing a narrow space behind. Meg and Lydia move closer, watching in fascination.
related_events: Characters enter master bedroom and assess surroundings
Meg observes unusual corner in master bedroom
Optical illusion revealed in closet mirror alignment

name: Evan Reveals Hidden Passage in Master Bedroom
description: Evan pushes on the top of the mirror mounted on the wall. It emits a faint click and slides open a few inches. He grasps the edge and swings it wide, rotating it 180 degrees until it snaps magnetically against the back of the closet door. Behind it, a smooth wall is revealed, containing a narrow vertical crack. Without hesitation, Evan presses the panel again—first at the top, then at the bottom. Each press produces a soft click. The panel swings open, fully exposing a hidden passage. Meg and Lydia step forward, their eyes fixed on the opening.
related_events: Evan demonstrates hidden mechanism in wall mirror
Hidden wall panel reveals vertical crack
Evan activates second hidden mechanism in wall
Meg and Lydia react to discovery of hidden passage

name: The Man Sees the Nightlight in the Bathroom
description: One floor up, the Man stepped into the hallway and moved toward the stairs, descending quickly and confidently. As he passed the top floor bathroom, he glanced to the side and froze. Inside the open doorway, a Power Puff Girls nightlight was plugged into an outlet along the baseboard. He stopped still, staring at it, then turned back and climbed the stairs again. He approached the bathroom door, looked from the nightlight to the countertop, where a moving box sat. His eyes widened. He took a step back and exhaled sharply. Turning toward the end of the hall, he noticed now, in the dimness, a faint glow coming from under the door of the fourth floor bedroom.
related_events: The Man notices a Power Puff Girls nightlight in the top floor bathroom
The Man freezes upon seeing something disturbing in the bathroom

name: The Man Finds a Moving Box in the Bathroom
description: The Man climbs back up the stairs and returns to the bathroom door. He steps inside the doorway and looks at the countertop, where a moving box sits. His eyes widen. He takes a step back and breathes deeply, then stands still, staring at the box.
related_events: The Man climbs the stairs again and approaches the bathroom door
The Man notices a moving box on the bathroom countertop
The Man reacts with shock to the discovery of the moving box

name: Notice Light Under the Bedroom Door
description: The Man stands in the hallway, his eyes adjusting to the dark. He looks toward the end of the hall and sees a faint glow coming from beneath the door of the fourth floor bedroom. He steps closer, recognizing the soft illumination as light from a nightlight inside the room.
related_events: The Man looks down the hallway and notices light under the fourth floor bedroom door
The Man detects light from another nightlight inside the fourth floor bedroom

name: Exploring the Third Floor and Learning About Bernard Pearlstine
description: The trio walks through the empty rooms on the third floor. Evan moves ahead, naming each space as they pass—spare bedroom, den, master bath, and then a closet. Lydia speaks quietly to Meg, telling her that Bernard Pearlstine, the man who once lived there, was a wealthy recluse known for his paranoia. She adds that he was worth millions, but now his children are fighting over his estate, and half the money can't be found. As she finishes, a metallic groaning comes from the hallway—the elevator—accompanied by the laughter of a little girl playing with it. Evan flinches, his voice tight, and asks if the child could stop. Lydia calls out, 'Kid! No elevator!' then winks at Meg.
related_events: Trio moves through empty rooms on the third floor
Lydia informs Meg about Bernard Pearlstine
Lydia reveals details about Bernard Pearlstine's estate dispute

name: Evan Objects to Gossip, Lydia Mocks Formal Speech
description: As the group moves through the third floor, Lydia whispers to Meg about Bernard Pearlstine, the reclusive hotel magnate whose children are now suing each other over his missing fortune. Evan interrupts, saying the gossip has nothing to do with showing the house. Lydia ignores him, turning to Meg and muttering that calling it 'the property' sounds ridiculous. From the hallway, the sound of the elevator groans as the little girl laughs and rides it up and down. Evan winces, speaking stiffly, and asks if the child could stop. Lydia calls out, 'KID! NO ELEVATOR!' then winks at Meg.
related_events: Evan expresses discomfort with Lydia's family gossip during property showing
Lydia quietly reprimands Meg for referring to the house as 'the property'

name: Lydia Stops the Girl from Riding the Elevator
description: The little girl's laughter echoes through the hallway as she repeatedly sends the elevator up and down, each movement accompanied by a loud groaning metallic sound. Evan winces, his voice tight as if speaking causes pain, and he asks that the child be made to stop. Lydia calls out sharply, 'KID! NO ELEVATOR!' After delivering the command, she turns to Meg and winks.
related_events: Little girl plays with elevator, causing groaning metallic sound
Evan winces and complains about the child's elevator use
Lydia shouts at the child to stop using the elevator and winks at Meg

name: Rise to the Skylight and the Intruder on the Roof
description: The view moves upward from the kitchen floor, rising past the entry floor and along the stair banister toward the top floor of the house. As it ascends, a skylight becomes visible in the roof above. A man in dark clothes appears on the roof, stepping into view. He pauses, looks down through the skylight, then walks across it. The perspective shifts, following the faint sound of his footsteps moving across the roof surface.
related_events: Camera-like perspective ascends through the house toward the skylight
Man in dark clothes appears and peers through the skylight
Man in dark clothes walks across the skylight
Perspective follows faint footsteps on the roof

name: Enter the Closet and Find the Shifting Roof Panel
description: In the hallway outside Sarah's bedroom, the closet door stands slightly open. Inside the closet, it is dark until a thin sliver of light appears from above. The source becomes clear: a square panel in the ceiling, leading to roof access, shifts subtly, letting moonlight spill in. Along the edge of the opening, a shiny silver object slides through the widening gap, moving slowly, deliberately, until it stops at a small round nub. A brief hum fills the space, followed by a spark and a soft crack as the device activates.
related_events: Closet door is found ajar outside Sarah's bedroom
Sliver of light appears from above in the closet
Roof access panel shifts slightly, allowing moonlight to enter

name: Silver Device Triggers Roof Access Mechanism
description: A slender silver object slips through the narrow gap around the roof access panel in the closet ceiling. It glides along the edge, pausing when it meets a small round nub embedded in the frame. A low hum fills the space as the device emits a pulse of electricity. A spark flashes, followed by a soft crack, and the panel shifts slightly under the force of the activation.
related_events: Silver device slides through the crack of the roof access panel
Silver device detects and interacts with a round nub in the panel crack

name: Observer watches van arrive across the street
description: The observer moves from the master bedroom, drifting down through the house from the third floor, passing through the entry level, and descending to the ground floor kitchen. They glide across the dark kitchen, weaving between stacked moving boxes, and approach the window that faces the street. Pressed close to the glass, they watch as a van pulls up across the street and comes to a stop. The driver's door opens and a man climbs out, dressed in dark clothes. He closes the door, looks both ways, and begins walking toward the house, carrying a bag.
related_events: Observer moves from master bedroom to kitchen window
Van arrives and stops across the street

name: Man Attempts to Enter House with Key, Then Leaves
description: A van pulls up across the street and stops. The driver’s door opens and a man climbs out. He wears dark clothes and closes the door behind him, glancing both ways before crossing the street toward the house. He approaches the front door and pulls out a key, sliding it into the lock. He turns it, jiggles it, tries again, but the lock does not open. After several attempts, he pulls the key out, steps back, and walks away from the door.
related_events: Man exits van and approaches house across the street
Man from van attempts to unlock front door with key

name: Man Attempts Entry Through Front Door, Then Uses Fire Escape
description: The man steps out of the van and approaches the front door, where he tries a key in the lock. It doesn't turn. He pulls the key out, reinserts it, and jiggles it, but the door remains locked. He steps back, looks both ways on the street, then walks to the kitchen window. The window is barred, and he peers inside, seeing only darkness. He glances at the street again, then climbs onto the window ledge. His legs rise into view as he reaches up. A metal fire escape lowers with a sharp scrape. The man begins to climb, his feet disappearing upward as he ascends.
related_events: Man from van peers into barred kitchen window
Man from van climbs onto window ledge and lowers fire escape

name: Observer retreats through kitchen toward stairwell
description: The man climbs onto the fire escape, his feet disappearing above the window. The observer turns away, gliding back through the dark kitchen, weaving between the stacked moving boxes, and moves toward the stairwell.
related_events: Observer retreats through kitchen toward stairwell

name: Evan Demonstrates the Panic Room's Safety Beams
description: Lydia stands near the panic room door, expressing concern that it could be a safety hazard. Evan responds by pointing to a thin red beam of light crossing the doorway at shoulder height. He explains it is an infrared sensor, like the ones in elevator doors, designed to prevent the door from closing if something is in the way. To demonstrate, he crouches down and blocks a second beam at shin level with his hand. He reaches up to press the door close button but can't do so while keeping his hand in the lower beam. He asks Lydia to press the button for him. Meg, standing nearby, says, 'Don't!' Lydia presses the button anyway, but the door doesn't move. Evan pulls his hand out of the beam and steps back. Lydia presses the button again. The heavy metal door slams shut with a loud clang, echoing through the room. Moments later, the false wall panel slides shut with a low hum, followed by the mirror on the closet door, which detaches and glides silently back into place, sealing the hidden entrance. Outside, the side door of a van slides open, and two more men climb out. Dressed in dark clothes and carrying satchels, they cross the street and approach the house. The first, Burnham, slips a silvery strip through the kitchen door gap. A hum and spark follow, and an alarm panel flashes: ZONE 1 DISABLED. He opens the door, letting the others in. Raoul, a hulking man, and Junior, smaller and tense, step inside. They all freeze, staring at the boxes. Junior mutters, "Fuck." Burnham says, "I know." Raoul asks what’s wrong.
